messages.subject: Sample joining
parts:
Hello All,

I am new to R and trying methylkit for methylation data analysis. 

I have completed initial processing using BSMAP and generated output using methratio.py. 

I could able to load the data for individual samples into methylkit using the way mentioned in : http://zvfak.blogspot.in/2012/10/how-to-read-bsmap-methylation-ratio.html 

Now, I would like to further analysis and for that need to merge the data from all the sample. 

Regarding that, Could you please send me the steps.

Thanking you with best regards

Sandip
